purpose: Designs document search: pre-search staleness judgment, the search result contract, the semantic search AI role and its ToC copy, and DLID resolution.
summary: Pre-search check: no confirmed ToC, rebuild not needed, rebuild needed, or undeterminable
User choice between rebuilding first or searching the existing version, with rebuild scale shown
Undeterminable results are treated as failures and stop the search
Search result contract: document ID, recorded path, reason, section, key, version, freshness
Search AI reads all entries of the ToC copy and prefers avoiding missed documents
Contents of the ToC copy: document info and section headings, without paths, hashes, or references
Read-only behavior: workers do not invent IDs or modify the ToC or managed state
resolve-dlid resolves DLIDs from recorded paths, verifying against the actual files
Resolution outcomes: resolved with anchor and hash, not at recorded path, no record
tasks: Implementing search and the pre-search check
Designing the search AI agent and ToC copy
title: DES-006 文書検索設計
